description: State held outside React (a module, a browser API, a library) that components read and subscribe to.
`useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot?)` reads an external store consistently and re-renders on change.
The value returned by `getSnapshot`. It must stay `Object.is` equal while the store is unchanged.
Visual inconsistency where parts of the UI show different versions of the same store during a concurrent render.
A function picking a slice of the state, so components re-render only when that slice changes.
